purpose: Provide a portable, client-neutral Codex user overlay without becoming a Codex runtime or taking ownership of private Codex state.

owns: eight explicitly named user skill roots under $HOME/.agents/skills
one repository-controlled command rules file under $CODEX_HOME/rules
three field-level config defaults when the user has not already set them
plan/apply/verify/rollback evidence for its own managed assets
does_not_own: provider, model, base URL, routing, quota, or billing
authentication, tokens, cookies, credentials, or private keys
MCP servers, plugins, sessions, memory, Desktop state, or sandbox internals
project source trees, project task ledgers, project telemetry, or project sidecars
Git commits, pushes, pull requests, releases, or external project writes

allowed: fail closed on conflicts or unsafe paths
atomic update of owned guidance block
replace the eight owned skill roots
write missing managed config fields only
owned skill count and hash readback
remove or restore only assets still matching this overlay's recorded ownership/hash
never: restore from untrusted or unrecorded content

invoke.reason: The overlay configures Codex; it does not launch tasks, call providers, or perform project work.

evidence_requirements: apply result with managed field names only
verify status PASS and issues empty
native Windows path readback on Windows
no credentials, tokens, sessions, or config正文 in evidence
non_goals: global agent personality or chat product
universal project governance without project-local contracts
production release or portable Codex installer
